applies_to: EBTRON IAQ-N200 wall-mount sensors measuring relative humidity and temperature.
summary: The IAQ-N200 is an EBTRON wall-mount room sensor for relative humidity and temperature with an RS-485 port that runs BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU when set by DIP switch). Its BACnet objects are a few Analog Inputs for the measurements plus Analog and Binary Values for baud rate and calibration.
notes: Points from Tables A2, A3-2 and A4 of the guide, which covers the IAQ-N100, IAQ-N200 and IAQ-N300 together.
The AV and BV objects are calibration and setup values, not control points.
Units are not printed per object; they are taken from the range and description columns.

source.title: IAQ-Ny00-W Quick Installation Guide - Wall Mount Indoor Air Quality Sensors with RS-485 Network Output (Appendix A)

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC address and baud rate on DIP switch SW1 before power-up, then read the measurement AIs. The AVs and BVs are only for calibration and setup.
setup: MAC address defaults to 2; set 0-127 on SW1 switches 1-7 with power off.
Device instance defaults to 2; DIP switch 8 on at power-up copies the MAC address into the instance, or write the Device Object_Identifier.
MS/TP baud defaults to 76,800; 38,400, 19,200 or 9,600 can be set on SW1 switches 1-4 or through the Baud Rate AV.
gotchas: Writing gain/offset values changes the reading; the factory Gain/Offset Status BVs switch back to factory calibration.
